title: Hanging Potato
body:
Inspired by **Potato Battery**, this resource pack replaces Hanging Signs with potatoes.  
If waterlogged, Hanging Potato turns poisonous and copper chain will oxidize.  
**Chinese** and **English** are supported.  
You can also download **[Hanging Potato Recipes](https://modrinth.com/datapack/hanging-potato-recipes)** data pack to make more sense.(?)
